sentence: Builds a gene editing method for crops that delivers editing complexes into pollen cells, without tissue culture or foreign DNA.
Uses algebraic geometry to solve problems in science and engineering that can be written as systems of polynomial equations.
Develops radical polymers and studies how their structure affects spin transport.
Sets up a system that uses mass spectrometry and infrared spectroscopy to identify bacteria, including antibiotic-resistant bacteria.
Studies the properties of insulating materials in thin film metal-insulator-metal structures used in plasmonic sensors.
Tries to find out how saltwater intrusion changes plant-microbe interactions in coastal marshes and affects plant coexistence and invasion.
Studies how precious metals and electric polarization change measured oxygen exchange rates of thin films used in high-temperature devices.
Expands a large language model for studying conflict and armed violence to Arabic and Spanish, so it can find political actors and events.
Studies why AI systems produce fabricated or inaccurate outputs in digital forensic investigations and develops ways to explain and measure how reliable they are.
Designs a testbed that measures how well metal powder spreads in layers, for additive manufacturing.
Studies distant quasars to find out how supermassive black holes and their host galaxies grew in the early Universe.
Develops formal verification methods that check quantum software is correct, using abstractions to make the checking work at large scale.
Develops ways to make and combine labs-on-a-chip for easy diagnosis of human health, agriculture, and the environment.
Builds a system that uses deep learning to analyze tutoring dialogues and give tutors feedback on the discourse strategies they use.
Builds a computational model of bone metastasis that combines 3D images of bone, cancer data, and bone-strength measurements to estimate fracture risk.
Tries to find out how legume plants choose soil bacteria partners to obtain nitrogen, by studying chemical signals and plant genes.
Studies how organic matter reacts with sulfide in anoxic zones of the ocean, which may help preserve organic carbon in sediments.
